meaning:
ἐπ-ακούω
[in LXX for שָׁמַע, עָנָה, etc. ;]
1. to listen to.
2. to hearken to, hear with favour (one's prayer): with genitive of person(s), 2Co.6:2 (LXX).†
(AS)
